facts.value: Early excavators took the carbonised scrolls for logs or fishing nets. Many were thrown away before one was dropped and broke open.
facts.quote: early excavators assumed they were logs or carbonized fishing nets
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://www.getty.edu/art/exhibitions/villa_papiri/inner.html' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'early excavators assumed they were logs or carbonized fishing nets'

facts.value: The villa was excavated by tunnelling. Convicts and conscripts dug the shafts and tunnels under Karl Weber.
